svg.title: straitjacket
svg.desc: Context containment harness for coding agents. A 304,113-token log becomes a roughly 210-token digest, and the one anomalous line keeps an exact retrieval address.
svg.text: Unbounded tool output becomes an immutable
The transcript stays an index over evidence —
1× L14238 fell back to legacy gw
the needle survives, with an address
